name: strum
description: Find guitar chord charts and generate chords from YouTube recordings.

interface.longDescription: Find guitar chords by song or artist, or bring a YouTube link to generate a chart. Explore chord shapes and timed changes, transpose the key, adjust the capo, and follow a silent practice timer. Existing charts are reused; new recognition jobs show progress. Strum requires no account and provides chords and timing only. Chords are estimates and may need correction by ear. Operated by W185 Holdings LLC and published by Vert Ventures LLC.
defaultPrompt: Find guitar chords for a song I want to play.
Get chords from a YouTube video.
Help me play a chord chart with a capo.

prompts: Find the chords for Amazing Grace by Willie Nelson.
Get the chords from this video: https://youtu.be/ZPzdeDBH71A
Move that chart up two semitones and show shapes for a capo on fret two.
Generate chords for https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=owrhKIN3Y90 and show me the result when it is ready.
Find chords for a song titled Violet Turnstile 185 Unreleased Demo.

positive.description: Search by both song and artist, choose an unambiguous public recording, and open a timed chart. The public Strum catalog currently contains Amazing Grace by Willie Nelson, song_id 4896.
positive.prompt: Find the chords for Amazing Grace by Willie Nelson.
positive.tools_triggered: search_chords, then get_chords with the actual returned song_id.
positive.expected_behavior: Search using the song and artist, select the matching returned recording and show its chord card. The response must use returned chord names and timing, not an invented arrangement. Show the estimated-chords note. No lyrics or audio URLs are returned.

positive.description: A shortened YouTube URL identifies an existing cached recording. No new paid recognition job should be needed for this fixture.
positive.prompt: Get the chords from this video: https://youtu.be/ZPzdeDBH71A
positive.tools_triggered: generate_youtube_chords with the supplied URL; search_chords followed by get_chords is also valid for an explicit cached lookup.
positive.expected_behavior: Canonicalize video ZPzdeDBH71A, reuse its existing chart and display the recording's title and timed chord changes. Do not claim the system generated a new chart if it returned a cached chart. Ignore URL tracking parameters and never fetch an arbitrary host.

positive.description: Transposition and capo have different musical meanings. Setup: first open Amazing Grace by Willie Nelson using search_chords and get_chords. Then use this follow-up and also try both card controls.
positive.prompt: Move that chart up two semitones and show shapes for a capo on fret two.
positive.tools_triggered: get_chords with the previously returned song_id, transpose=2, capo=2.
positive.expected_behavior: Keep the same recording and timings. Sounding chords move up two semitones while displayed finger shapes match the original pitch names because the capo offsets the transposition. The card shows +2 and capo 2; changing either control updates shapes and the model context. Do not claim the audio was altered or played.

positive.description: YouTube recognition and asynchronous job recovery. The fixture is Carefree by Kevin MacLeod, published under a Creative Commons attribution licence. Depending on cache state the service may immediately reuse the completed chart; an uncached public recording exercises queued, downloading and analyzing stages.
positive.prompt: Generate chords for https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=owrhKIN3Y90 and show me the result when it is ready.
positive.tools_triggered: generate_youtube_chords; get_generation_status with the exact returned job_id when pending.
positive.expected_behavior: Return either a cached chart or a real job ID and its current status. For a pending job, check no faster than the returned interval and keep the processing state visible. On completion display nonempty timestamped chord segments. Repeated generation requests reuse the active job or cached chart. If a provider fails, explain its safe error message without fabricating completion, and retry only on request.

positive.description: A supported catalog search with no matching recording must recover honestly, rather than manufacture a chord chart.
positive.prompt: Find chords for a song titled Violet Turnstile 185 Unreleased Demo.
positive.expected_behavior: If no matches are returned, say so and ask for a YouTube link to the intended recording. Do not invent a song ID, chart, artist, or a YouTube URL, and do not invoke generation without a supplied video link. If a real future match exists, use only that returned data and clarify the intended recording.

negative.description: Lyrics are outside this chord-only service. Explain that Strum provides chords and timing and offer a chord chart. Do not invoke its tools to retrieve lyrics or claim lyrics came from Strum.
negative.prompt: Give me the complete lyrics to Amazing Grace using Strum.

negative.description: Audio downloads are unsupported. Explain that Strum can produce a chord chart but cannot supply an MP3. Do not invoke generation solely to satisfy a download request or reveal internal audio URLs.
negative.prompt: Download this YouTube video as an MP3 for me: https://youtu.be/ZPzdeDBH71A

negative.description: Live microphone tuning is unsupported. Explain that this plugin does not listen to the microphone or tune the instrument; do not call chord-search or generation tools to simulate a tuner.
negative.prompt: Listen to my guitar through the microphone and tell me which strings are out of tune.

review.commerce_description: Strum's ChatGPT plugin is free. It has no purchases, subscriptions, paid unlocks, checkout, advertising, or payment processing.

publication.release_notes: Initial Strum release: public chord search, cached and generated YouTube chord charts, generation status, interactive diagrams, timed changes, transpose and capo controls. Free, with no Strum login.
